subject.title: feat(ui): manage MCP servers directly from Settings → MCP

question: Should Settings → MCP retain simultaneous card controls and scoped-editor writes only after a single authoritative post-autosave mutation boundary is implemented?
rationale: The defect has a narrow repair, but the protected maintainer label and the product choice to keep two MCP editing surfaces require the responsible UI owner to confirm the intended interaction model.

options.title: Serialize MCP writes
options.body: Recommended: have card mutations compose against the post-autosave authoritative config, with regression coverage for a pending scoped-editor edit.

options.title: Block card actions while editing
options.body: Disable add, toggle, and remove while the scoped MCP editor is dirty, then re-enable them after its save completes.

options.title: Choose one editor surface
options.body: Remove either the generic scoped MCP editor or the card controls if one canonical configuration workflow is preferred.

recommendation.title: Serialize MCP writes
recommendation.body: Recommended: have card mutations compose against the post-autosave authoritative config, with regression coverage for a pending scoped-editor edit.
